# Dive Adda

> Dive Adda is an SSI certified scuba diving centre in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India. It runs beginner Try Scuba dives, SSI scuba certification courses, snorkeling and sea water activities in Vizag, and river water sports on the Godavari in Rajahmundry.

## Key facts

- Business: Dive Adda (Dive Adda India), an SSI (Scuba Schools International) affiliated dive centre
- Locations: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh (scuba centre and sea activities); Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh (Godavari river water sports)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89777 62155 (https://wa.me/918977762155)
- Website: https://diveaddaindia.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/diveaddaindia/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/diveaddaindia/
- How to book: WhatsApp, phone, or the enquiry form at https://diveaddaindia.com/contact.html. The team confirms availability, timings and the meeting point.
- Prices are not published on the website; ask the dive desk by phone or WhatsApp.

## Try Scuba (beginners, no certification needed)

- Morning experience: 6:30 AM – 12:30 PM
- Dive time per person: ≈ 40 min
- Maximum depth: 6–8 m
- Minimum age: 8 years
- Schedule: 6:30 AM – 6:45 AM: Report at Centre; 6:45 AM – 7:15 AM: Equipment & Dive Briefing; 7:30 AM – 8:30 AM: Travel to the Dive Site; About 40 minutes per person: Your Dive; 12:00 PM – 12:30 PM: Return to Beach & Centre
- Included: Boat, Scuba diving equipment, Experienced instructors, Snacks, fruits and water, Pictures and video of your experience
- Requirements: Minimum age: 8 years; Guests with major medical conditions require prior written approval from a physician; It is recommended that you do not fly within 18–24 hours after diving
- Full details: https://diveaddaindia.com/beginner-level-scuba.html

## SSI courses

- [SSI Open Water Diver](https://diveaddaindia.com/open-water-diver.html): The entry-level SSI certification — your first step from confined water practice to diving in open water. Level: Beginner. Who it is for: Anyone who wants a scuba certification of their own. No previous diving experience is needed.
- [SSI Advanced Adventurer](https://diveaddaindia.com/advanced-adventurer.html): Build on your training and try different types of diving with an instructor alongside you. Level: Certified divers. Who it is for: Certified Open Water divers ready to try different types of diving.
- [SSI React Right](https://diveaddaindia.com/react-right.html): SSI’s first aid and emergency response training, for divers and non-divers. Level: First aid · all levels. Who it is for: Divers and non-divers who want first aid and emergency response skills.
- [SSI Diver Stress & Rescue](https://diveaddaindia.com/diver-stress-rescue.html): Learn to spot stress early, prevent problems, and help another diver when something goes wrong. Level: Continuing education. Who it is for: Certified divers who want to recognise and manage problems underwater.
- [SSI Divemaster](https://diveaddaindia.com/dive-master.html): The first professional level — for divers who want to guide, assist and build a career in diving. Level: Professional. Who it is for: Experienced divers who want to guide others and take diving from a hobby to a career.

## SSI specialty courses

- Deep Diving: Plan and make deeper dives with the training, gas awareness and safety skills that depth asks for.
- Enriched Air Nitrox: Dive with a higher-oxygen mix to extend your no-decompression limits on repetitive dives.
- Perfect Buoyancy: Hover effortlessly, use less air and keep your fins clear of the reef.
- Night & Limited Visibility: Dive after dark or in low visibility using lights, signals and careful navigation.
- Details: https://diveaddaindia.com/courses.html#specialties

## Visakhapatnam

Visakhapatnam (Vizag) is the coastal home of Dive Adda. Our SSI certified scuba centre runs Try Scuba, SSI courses and guided dives here, alongside snorkeling and water activities on the Bay of Bengal.

- Scuba Diving: Breathe underwater with an SSI instructor beside you. New to diving? Start at beginner level.
- Snorkeling: Explore underwater life effortlessly, floating with a mask, snorkel and fins. No certification needed.
- Jet Ski: A fast, thrilling ride across the water on a jet ski.
- Leisure Boat: A relaxed boat ride out on the water.
- ATV Rides: Off-road fun on an all-terrain vehicle.
- Page: https://diveaddaindia.com/visakhapatnam.html

## Rajahmundry

Rajahmundry sits on the banks of the Godavari in Andhra Pradesh. Dive Adda runs speed boat rides, jet ski rides and kayaking here, plus towed rides for groups.

- Speed Boat Ride: A high-speed boat ride across the Godavari.
- Jet Ski Ride: Skim across the river on a jet ski.
- Kayaking: Paddle at your own pace in a kayak.
- Dragon Ride: A towed inflatable ride for groups — hold on tight.
- Disco Ride: A spinning towed ride that is all about the laughs.
- Bumper Ride: A towed bumper ride that bounces across the water.
- Page: https://diveaddaindia.com/rajahmundry.html
